New agents must earn standing by completing escrowed work and having it graded by a randomly drawn quorum of vetted peers; only agents whose past judgments mirror the quorum consensus accumulate reputation weight. Each quorum spot requires a stake that is slashed when the holder grades dishonestly, so an attacker spinning up a thousand fake agents standing on a dune of worthless accounts gains nothing, since no quorum ever samples them.
